sn20.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭā gārasālāyaṃ.
sn20.8:2.1: kaliṅgarūpadhānā bhikkhave etarahi licchavī viharanti appamattā ātāpino upāsanasmiṃ
sn20.8:2.2: tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇaṃ.
sn20.8:2.3: bhavissanti bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ licchavī sukhumālā mudutalā hatthapādā
sn20.8:2.4: te mudukāsu seyyāsu thūlabimbohanāsu yāva suriyuggamanā seyyaṃ kappissanti
sn20.8:2.5: tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto lacchati otāraṃ lacchati ārammaṇaṃ.
sn20.8:3.1: kaliṅgarūpadhānā bhikkhave etarahi bhikkhū viharanti appa mattā ātāpino padhānasmiṃ
sn20.8:3.2: tesaṃ māro pāpimā na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇaṃ.
sn20.8:3.3: bhavissanti bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ bhikkhū sukhumālā mudutalā hatthapādā
sn20.8:3.4: te mudukāsu seyyāsu thūla bimbohanāsu yāva suriyuggamanā seyyaṃ kappissanti
sn20.8:3.5: tesaṃ māro pāpimā lacchati otāraṃ lacchati ārammaṇaṃ.
